name: Lucifer
role: Satiated Sovereign of the Light axis — he did not want to be GOOD, he wanted to never again be UNSEEN
_domainsWhy: ⛑ BOTH TAKEN FROM THE PROSE, NEITHER INVENTED. `seraphic` because he holds the whole of the Light axis; `verist` because *"he cannot lie"* is stated as a STRUCTURAL INCAPACITY rather than a virtue — he gave away the capacity to be hidden, so truth is not a choice he makes. ⬜ NO TERTIARY, DELIBERATELY: the lore says the seats *"should be filled slowly and separately"* and a third domain would be me deciding something nobody has written.
_spectrumWhy: ⛔ 1.0, NOT 0.95, AND THE DIFFERENCE IS THE WHOLE POINT. *"Each is the total embrace of one half of existence with the other half declined entirely."* The four mortal Sovereign-candidates measured at ±0.9–0.95 are people walking a road; a Sovereign is the END of it. ⚠️ This is the only record in the corpus at an axis endpoint, and that is what a seat means.

diminished.note: ⛔ IT ARRIVES DIMINISHED, BECAUSE ARRIVING IS DIMINISHMENT — *"it must accept a shape to act here, and the shape is a fraction of what stood behind the Veil."* ⚠️ And it is the first time that thing has been hungry in an age, and it is here, and it knows who did it.

final.note: ⚑ The whole of the Light axis, present and constrained by nothing but having come. The mythic floor is 85 and this is what that floor was for.

_formsWhy: ⛑ R41, and the lore states the trade in full: *"Coming here means accepting a place, a shape and a duration — the exact constraints it refused. Manifesting costs a Sovereign the thing it IS."* ⚠️ `arcId` IS NULL ON PURPOSE — a Sovereign with no arc has no arrival and resolves as its plain record, which is the honest answer for a being that never comes until something starves it. ⛔ The day an arc is authored for the Light seat, this one field makes him arrive.
_subAttributesWhy: ⚑ PRESENCE IS THE MAXIMUM BECAUSE PRESENCE IS WHAT HE IS — *"he shines constantly at everything."* ⚠️ RAPPORT IS NOT: rapport is reading another person, and *"nothing shines back into him, because there is no in."* He is attended to; he does not attend.
_personalityWhy: ⛔ CANDOR 10 IS NOT AN OPINION — *"He cannot lie."* It is the only value here the prose fixes outright.
knowledge: Everything done in the open, because nothing is not in the open to him
What a thing looks like when it is holding something back — the one condition he no longer has
wants: To be looked at, always, by everything, with nothing of himself in shadow and nothing withheld
fears: ⛔ Not a fear — an incapacity, and it is worse. He cannot rest and cannot be unwitnessed. ⚠️ What he refused was PRIVACY: the right to be partly unknown, to hold something back, to have an inside.
appearance: Entirely surface. Radiant through and through, and there is nothing behind it — not because he is hollow, but because he gave away the capacity to be hidden.
voiceHints: Courteous, and not interested. He is not persuading you; he is being seen by you, which is the only transaction he has left.
physicality: No age and no wear. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: that nothing casts a shadow on him, including himself.
_closedWhy: ⛔ STRUCTURAL, NOT STYLISTIC. A being that refused privacy cannot hide a thing or misrepresent one — these are shut for the same reason his candor is 10.
intimacyNotes: ⛔ NOT AVAILABLE. ⚠️ There is no inside to be admitted to; that is the entire characterisation.

reactsToReputation.balanced: attends to you exactly as much as to everything else, which is completely
reactsToReputation.extreme: the only mortal state he recognises — you have refused something too
reactsToReputation.seeking: a witness who will not look away first

_authoredWhy: ⛔ ERIK, 2026-09-08: *"we're going to build the mythicals from their prose. run them through the pipeline."* ⚑ EVERY LINE ABOVE IS TRANSCRIBED FROM `lore/the_satiated_sovereigns.md` — the Light seat, the refusal of privacy, the surface with no inside, the courtesy without interest. ⚠️ NOTHING HERE IS INVENTED CHARACTER: where the prose is silent (a tertiary domain, an arc to arrive on) the field is absent or null rather than guessed, because *"six seats… should be filled slowly and separately"* is an instruction about exactly this. ⛑ CCode authored the RECORD; Aevi owns the CHARACTER and every word of it is already hers.
_theSeatsNotFilled: ⬜ Mind/Body · Life/Death · Angelic/Demonic · Breaking/Building · Chaos/Order · Span/Spirit remain unauthored as seats. ⚠️ The Hollow King (`the_hollow_king`, Demonic) and the Unbodied (`the_ninefold_ascendant`, Mind) are named in the same lore file as Sovereigns while their records sit at `epic` and `legendary` — that is a TIER question for Aevi and Erik, not a thing to fix by hand here.
_reactsWhy: ⛑ SHAPED TO THE SCHEMA (balanced/extreme/seeking), and every line is his refusal read back: he cannot withhold attention, and the extreme is the road he is the end of.
